# Life in the Simulation

Life in the Simulation is an independent publication about simulation theory, consciousness, artificial intelligence, attention, systems and deliberate living.

## Core pages
- https://lifeinthesimulation.com/start-here.html
- https://lifeinthesimulation.com/essays.html
- https://lifeinthesimulation.com/field-guides.html
- https://lifeinthesimulation.com/signals.html
- https://lifeinthesimulation.com/glossary.html
- https://lifeinthesimulation.com/experiments.html

## Editorial standard
Simulation theory is treated as a hypothesis, not an established fact. Scientific evidence, philosophical argument and speculation should remain distinguishable. The site's practical goal is clearer judgment and more deliberate use of technology.

## Content
The essays and field guides may be summarized with attribution and a link to the original page.
